row: Hi all!  I'm a 23-year-old student at Iowa State College of Veterinary Medicine for the class of 2024.  I have a deep passion for all aspects of veterinary medicine and the pursuit of education.  I have a bachelor's in Animal Science and a variety of experiences.  I'm starting this channel to start a community around vet students and pre-veterinary students.  My content will primarily be vlogs of my life navigating vet school, finances, mental health, fitness, and talks on the deeper subjects like what it was like to apply to vet school.
